records.sourceWork: Novena for the Holy Souls in Purgatory
records.edition: Traditional English prayer-book recension; public-domain original
records.finding: Nine linked day-by-day modern prayer-book transcriptions reproduce the English day prayers and prescribe, on all days, an Our Father, Hail Mary, four-line On Thy spouses verse, then seven O most sweet Jesus intercessions. The app formerly omitted the repeated four-line verse, now restored in V4 only. The original print edition has not been identified or independently collated.
